MouseSella.name: Sella
MouseAdele.name: Adele
MouseMandel.name: Mandel
MouseBaldwin.name: Baldwin
MouseJoyce.name: Joyce
MouseIvy.name: Ivy
MouseLucas.name: Lucas
MouseMatthew.name: Matthew
MouseElijah.name: Elijah
MouseNolan.name: Nolan
MouseAlyssa.name: Alyssa
MouseReagan.name: Reagan
MouseLetita.name: Letita
MouseVegetable.name: Mouse Vegetable
MouseVegetable.text: A tasty vegetable that mice love. It has a rich, cheesy flavor.
MouseVegetableSeeds.name: Mouse Vegetable Seeds
MouseVegetableSeeds.text: Grows in any season. Takes seven days to mature.
MouseBread.name: Mouse Cheese Bun
MouseBread.text: An unusual bread baked from cheese.
MouseBread_recipe.text: Thank you for the cheese! Maybe you're wondering why I wanted so much of it? It's because our mouse clan has a special way of cooking, passed down for generations, that turns cheese into delicious mouse bread. I'll teach you how to make it. Of course, I hear you humans don't really like it... but it's very healthy!
MouseBread_recipe.name: Sella
RatSword.name: Rat Greatsword
RatSword.text: According to the warrior mouse, this is his family heirloom. It seems to carry a mysterious sword aura that strikes farther than it should.
BuildMouseValley1.text: Notice:^To protect the rare Bread Mouse and Sleepy Mouse, the small valley north of Stardew Valley will be turned into a nature reserve, and housing will be built there for the protected animals. We ask all residents to bear with any inconvenience caused by the construction.^^Ferngill Republic Department of Wildlife Protection
BuildMouseValley1.title: Nature Reserve Construction Notice
RatSwordMail.text: @:^My wife has been longing for some delicious cheese lately, but we have never been able to get any. The only valuable thing I own is my family's heirloom sword. If you want it, bring me 20 cheese. Please, my wife really wants some tasty cheese.^^Kerwin, warrior mouse
RatSwordMail.title: Cheese for a Sword
RatSwordQuest.title: Cheese for a Sword
RatSwordQuest.text: Kerwin's wife Sella wants cheese. To make her happy, Kerwin is willing to trade his family heirloom sword for 20 delicious cheese.
RatSwordQuest.dialogue: Thank you so much, squeak! Such delicious cheese.#$b#Here, just as we agreed. It's yours now, squeak.#$b#Don't let it gather dust in a display case, squeak![(W)RatSword]
MouseFelixShop.text: All kinds of farm goods for sale.
Map_MVR.1: You press the power button, but nothing happens.
Map_MVR.2: The dried-up fish tank shows no sign that fish ever lived in it.
Map_MVR.3: The stool creaks so much that you don't dare sit on it.
Map_MVR.4: You don't want to open its door. Who knows what's inside.
Map_MVR.5: The ball has gone flat, though you can't find the puncture.
Map_MVR.6: The drumhead is torn. Its previous owner must have practiced very hard.
Map_MVR.7: You wipe off the dust. It reads: I, unafraid of being forgotten.
Map_MVR.9: Just a pile of dust. It was clearly emptied out before being dumped here.
Map_MVR.10: It looks like some animal lives inside. Unfortunately, you can't budge the heavy iron door.
Map_MVR.11: You're sure you've seen this thing somewhere before.
Map_MV.Construction: Clanging and banging echo from the hole. The mice asked you not to disturb them during construction. Come back in a few days.
Map_MV.Gen3Door: A closed door. Behind it you hear only silence: the room is waiting for the next generation of mice.
31279001.2: It dropped a cave carrot at the mouth of the hole... It's already smashed.
31279002.1: Ah, @. What can I do for you?
31279002.2: The hole in the mine? A mysterious creature?#$b#Impossible. No species like that lives in Stardew Valley.
31279002.3: Oh, of course I know what's on the other side of that hole.#$b#But I'm afraid we'll need to bother Mayor Lewis.#$b#Hey, Lewis!
31279002.5: @ just told me a mysterious creature ran into that little hole in the mine.#$b#I'm certain it isn't any species native to Stardew Valley.#$b#Mayor Lewis, that garbage hasn't just been left there, has it?#$b#You certainly collected plenty of garbage disposal tax last time.
31279002.6: Oh, no, no, I've already arranged it.#$b#It'll be cleared out within three days at most.
31279002.7: Good. @, if you're interested, you can crawl through that little hole and look around over the next few days.#$b#It's a remarkable place.
31279003.1: @, you'd better come take a look at this.
31279003.3: Oh, hello, squeak. I'm Felix the mouse.
31279003.5: Ahem. This place used to be Pelican Town's garbage dump.#$b#But environmental regulations require us to clear the garbage out.#$b#And yet they've already made their home here...
31279003.7: I'm so sorry for taking over your space, squeak, but we have nowhere else to go...
31279003.8: We? You're not the only one?
31279003.9: That's right. My wife, my brother, and his wife, squeak.#$b#They've all gone out looking for food, squeak squeak. I only just got back.
31279003.11: Are we causing you trouble? I'm sorry, we...
31279003.12: How about making this place a nature reserve?
31279003.14: Oh! @! That's brilliant.#$b#With so many animals living here, why couldn't it be a nature reserve? I'll go file the application right away.
31279003.15: Really? That's wonderful. Thank you both.
31279003.16: You suddenly remember the mouse you met in the cave. It doesn't seem to be this one. Maybe you should bring a cave carrot and look for it.
31279004.3: Oh, it's @, the human who suggested to the mayor that we be allowed to settle here, squeak!
31279004.4: You look familiar, squeak. Aren't you the one I ran into in the mine that day...
31279004.6: Oh, that's right, squeak. I did drop a carrot in the mine that day!
31279004.7: Thank you so much, squeak squeak! Oh, I haven't introduced everyone yet.
31279004.11: @, would you like to join us for lunch, squeak squeak? We have plenty of food now!
31279004.12: You see the cave carrot on the ground, smeared all over with cheese paste, and your appetite fades.
31279004.13: Oh, you've already eaten? What a pity, squeak.
31279004.15: The warmth of these adorable mice lifts your spirits. You feel delighted.
31279005.1: Is it really all right for us to accept this, squeak...
31279005.2: Squeak squeak. Father once taught me never to keep living on the kindness of others.
31279005.3: Squeak squeak, @, you're here! Have you heard? The humans are going to build us a house.
31279005.4: But we feel torn. We feel we've already received too much kindness from all of you, squeak...
31279005.5: @, as you can see, I'm a farmer just like you, squeak.
31279005.6: And I hear you're a brave warrior too, squeak squeak!
31279005.7: I was thinking, squeak, once we have a house, we could turn this place into Stardew Valley's next farm, just like %farm Farm, squeak squeak!
31279005.8: I'll join the cause of protecting Stardew Valley and fight monsters, squeak!
31279005.9: That's right, we'll become part of Stardew Valley, squeak. Why don't we call this place Mouse Valley, squeak squeak.
31279005.10: I mean 'Mouse Valley', of course, not 'Mouse Valley Squeak Squeak', squeak squeak!
31279005.11: Felix's earnest attempt to explain himself really is a little funny.
31279005.12: Stay tuned for the construction of Mouse Valley. Soon, the changes here will astonish you!
31279006.1: Oh! @! You really grew Mouse Vegetables!#$b#I thought that was impossible, squeak...
31279006.2: Mouse Vegetables were the first plant my father taught me to grow, squeak.#$b#I remember he took me every day to watch the Mouse Vegetables I had planted with my own paws.#$b#He made me record their growth cycle and taught me how to care for them best, squeak.#$b#But Father always told me:#$b#Mice are mice and humans are humans. Humans never grow mouse crops, and mice should only ever grow mouse crops.#$b#But now you, a human, have shown me you can grow Mouse Vegetables this well, squeak!#$b#Maybe I should try growing human crops, squeak.#$b#But if my father's spirit in the Mousewest Isle knew I had gone against everything he taught me...
31279006.4: Thank you, squeak!#$b#Yes, my father always held a prejudice against humans, but you've proven that humans can grow mouse vegetables very well, squeak.#$b#As fellow farmers, our love for the land and its crops can surely overcome prejudice between species.#$b#A farmer should plant with their own hands and experience everything this land can give us, squeak.#$b#Father taught me one more thing: always strive to be a great mouse farmer who belongs to the land!#$b#Now I know what I should do, squeak.#$b#Thank you, @. I'll try growing every human crop there is!#$b#If I become a great farmer, my father's spirit in the Mousewest Isle will be proud of me too, won't he, squeak...
31279007.1: Oh, @, hello.#$b#This is where we first met, isn't it, squeak? You gave me quite a fright back then.#$b#What am I trying to say, squeak? The truth is, I'm afraid you'll think less of me. I'm not a cowardly mouse, squeak squeak.#$b#Yes, you startled me, but what really scared me was the sound of the rock you kicked when you showed up, squeak...#$b#That sound reminded me of my little brother throwing stones to warn us, right before the great white snake swallowed him, squeak...#$b#So please forgive me for losing my nerve back then. I'm really not a cowardly mouse, squeak squeak.
31279007.2: My master was once an excellent warrior mouse, squeak squeak.#$b#His fighting skills were better than mine, and I never managed to surpass him.#$b#But he had one fatal weakness: he loved sweet rice wine far too much, squeak.#$b#A mouse who drinks sweet rice wine gets dizzy, babbles nonsense, and then passes out.#$b#My master drank it every day and passed out in the wild once a week, squeak.#$b#But one time, while he was passed out, a hawk found him...#$b#He was so strong that he would never have lost to that hawk in a fair fight. It was only because the wine knocked him out that he became the hawk's meal, squeak.#$b#So the last lesson my master taught me with his life, and the one way I can truly say I surpass him,#$b#is that I have sworn to always keep a clear head.#$b#Besides, my life doesn't belong only to me. It's also for protecting other mice.
31279007.3: I don't usually talk this much, squeak. Maybe I was just thinking of my master.#$b#He has gone to the Mousewest Isle. In our legends, that's where all departed mice go, squeak.#$b#Enough talk. I'm heading into the mine. Goodbye, squeak.#$b#Are you going down the mine too? Mice have their own mouse tunnels, so we probably won't run into each other, squeak.#$b#Good luck to us both, squeak squeak!
31279007.4: He's a mouse worthy of respect.#$b#But what did he mean by 'the white snake'? Why are they so afraid of it?
31279008.1: Wonderful! I found another one, squeak squeak
31279008.2: Oh! @! What are you doing here, squeak? I'm looking for food, squeak squeak
31279008.3: Stardew Valley is a land of plenty, squeak. There's food everywhere here. Look, I picked these mushrooms.#$b#That's also why we chose to settle in Stardew Valley, squeak.#$b#We stayed in a few different places before, and none of them had enough food, squeak.#$b#But Stardew Valley is different from all of them, squeak.#$b#We all believe Stardew Valley is protected by the Mousewest Clan.#$b#What is the Mousewest Clan? They're the heavenly mice born in the Mousewest Isle, where all departed mice go.#$b#The chief of the Mousewest Clan, the Great Mouse Spirit, is worshipped by mice the way you humans worship Yoba, squeak.#$b#I'm a faithful believer in the Great Mouse Spirit. Every time before I go foraging, I pray to the Great Mouse Spirit to grant us more food, squeak.#$b#Even before we came to Stardew Valley, I prayed that we would find a beautiful place to settle. And in the end, it turned out to be Stardew Valley, squeak squeak!
31279008.4: But... during those years in exile, why didn't the Great Mouse Spirit protect us, squeak...#$b#I prayed every day, and still food was so scarce.#$b#I had to teach the other three how to forage. We had to keep searching and searching, from dawn until night, just to find enough to fill our bellies, squeak.#$b#We were homeless for so long... It's such a painful memory, squeak.#$b#I hope it never happens again, squeak. Great Mouse Spirit, if you are still listening, please grant us a peaceful and happy life.#$b#Oh, I'm sorry, @, I've said too much. Mice have their gods and humans have theirs. I hope I didn't disrespect your Yoba...#$b#Well, I should go. I have enough food now, so it's time to head back.
31279008.5: You're very curious about the mouse clan's past, but seeing how downcast she looks, you don't dare bring it up.
31279009.1: You hear strange noises coming from Gus's storeroom.
31279009.2: Oh, @! Hello!#$b#Please don't get the wrong idea, I'm not here to steal anything.#$b#I'm here to... learn things, squeak squeak.
31279009.3: This is that plump human's place, I know that much.#$b#I really admire him, squeak squeak. He can make so many different kinds of food.#$b#He keeps some of his cooking tips and basic knowledge in here.#$b#This knowledge is simply astonishing, squeak.#$b#For example: humans combine fire with all sorts of things to cook, and that gives rise to so many cooking methods, squeak.#$b#Fire and water is boiling, fire and steam is steaming, fire and an iron plate is frying, fire and air is roasting...#$b#Before this, I never imagined fire could be used in so many ways, squeak.
31279009.4: How do we mice cook?#$b#@, I don't think I ever told you. Before that disaster, I wasn't a good mouse cook at all, squeak.#$b#Once, I was playing out in the wild and stayed out so late that I forgot to go home, squeak.#$b#Then a wolf spotted me. It carried me in its jaws back to its den, meaning to teach its cubs how to hunt.#$b#I didn't even dare cry or call for help, squeak... I could only watch those wolves come closer...#$b#But right then, Kerwin appeared. He had a sword, cut down those wolf cubs, and rescued me from the den, squeak.#$b#But just as I was feeling lucky to be alive, I found that he was badly wounded and barely breathing...#$b#I took him to a safe spot under a big tree. He needed food, but I didn't dare leave our shelter, squeak.#$b#So I gathered some wild greens from under the tree. That was the first time I ever cooked, squeak.
31279009.5: That pot of wild green soup saved both our lives, squeak.#$b#After we got back to the village safely, Kerwin and I got engaged. He also suggested I learn to cook, because he thought I had a gift for it, squeak.#$b#But not long after, 'it' came, squeak, and we were forced to flee in every direction.#$b#So I never learned many real cooking techniques, squeak.#$b#That's why I long so much to learn more. What I want most is to see someone's satisfied smile after they eat my food, squeak.#$b#Just like Kerwin's smile back then.#$b#Will you keep my secret, squeak?#$b#I know humans don't like mice, squeak squeak, especially cooks.#$b#But I'll keep learning. I want to learn more ways to cook, squeak.#$b#I'll become the first mouse chef who's the best at cooking human food, squeak.
31279009.6: Her determination truly moves you. You nod. You will keep this secret forever.
31279010.1: Dear, I failed again, squeak...#$b#I'm sorry. I keep making useless attempts, wasting the land and wasting time...
31279010.2: It's all right, squeak squeak...#$b#I believe in you, squeak. As long as you keep at it, you'll get results.#$b#I've always, always believed in you, squeak.
31279010.3: That looks like Felix and Nina. What are they talking about? I should go take a look.
31279010.4: Oh, @! When did you get here, squeak? Felix and I were just...
31279010.5: Dear, let me explain, squeak.#$b#I've been trying to crossbreed Mouse Vegetables with blueberries, so that the Mouse Vegetable's fruit could be eaten too.#$b#But I keep failing, squeak. Failing again and again.#$b#I've wasted my energy, and wasted land that could have grown more food, squeak squeak...
31279010.6: Look at these weeds, squeak. Not only do they bear no fruit, they don't even taste like Mouse Vegetables.#$b#Countless times I've dreamed of them bearing blue fruit, squeak squeak.#$b#But in reality, not even their leaves are edible, squeak.
31279010.7: Squeak, @, I wonder if you can understand him, squeak.#$b#Ever since you grew Mouse Vegetables and brought them to him, he's become obsessed, squeak squeak.#$b#He's determined to create a new crop that combines mouse and human crops, squeak.
31279010.9: It's all right, dear, squeak.#$b#I believe in you, squeak. @ believes in you too. We all believe in you, squeak squeak. Cheer up.
31279010.10: Thank you, dear, squeak.#$b#But, squeak, every day I see you head out at dawn to forage for wild greens and fruit, and you don't come back with a full basket until evening.#$b#If I could grow fruit that suits mouse tastes, you wouldn't have to work so hard, squeak.#$b#If that fruit were as plentiful as blueberries, we could dry it, and we'd never need to forage to fill our bellies again, squeak...#$b#Every time I see you so exhausted, it breaks my heart, squeak...
31279010.11: Listen to what you're saying!#$b#I don't need that, and I won't let you say that, squeak!#$b#Whether you grow Mouse Vegetables or fruit, I support you. That's your work, squeak.#$b#But you shouldn't say you're doing it for me, squeak!#$b#I'm fine. I love my foraging work, and I enjoy knowing my hard work fills everyone's bellies.#$b#Your work is for you, and so everyone can eat tastier food. Not for me, squeak!
31279010.12: Dear, I'm only telling the truth, squeak...#$b#Look at @, a fine farmer, squeak. Humans don't need to forage so hard to fill their bellies, squeak.#$b#Isn't the whole point of growing crops to have food without taking risks, squeak?
31279010.1_1: Felix, you need to respect your wife's work. I often forage for wild fruit too. It's an important way to get food.
31279010.1_2: I'm sorry, dear, squeak.#$b#@ is right. I should respect your work and your wishes, squeak.#$b#Now I understand that foraging is an important way to get food too, squeak.#$b#I was wrong. I shouldn't have forced my idea of 'what's good for you' on you, squeak.
31279010.1_3: Squeak...#$b#It's all right, dear, squeak.#$b#I'm looking forward to tasting the fruit you grow someday, too.#$b#You can do it, squeak squeak.
31279010.2_1: Nina, your husband is just worried about your safety. There are owls in this valley, and he worries when you forage until late.
31279010.2_2: Squeak...#$b#I'm sorry, I shouldn't have lost my temper, squeak.#$b#@ is right. I always lose track of time when I go out, and end up foraging in the valley until late.#$b#I'll keep an eye on the time from now on. I'm also looking forward to tasting the fruit you grow someday, squeak.
31279010.2_3: Thank you, dear, squeak.#$b#I was wrong too. I shouldn't have let my feelings hold you hostage, squeak.#$b#I'll keep working hard, squeak.
31279010.13: Looks like I should try again. Hmm, maybe I should try a different kind of fruit, squeak...
31279010.14: Felix has regained his fighting spirit, and you're glad. But Nina still seems upset. You should find a chance to talk with her alone.
31279011.1: Squeak... squeak squeak... squeak squeak squeak?
31279011.2: Sounds like there's a mouse in Robin's kitchen. Who is it?
31279011.3: Squeak, @! You scared me half to death, squeak!#$b#Good thing it's you. Is something the matter, squeak?
31279011.4: Me? I came to look at this oven, squeak.#$b#My wife has always wanted an oven, squeak squeak. I know it. She dreams of having an oven.#$b#One like the one in this human's house.#$b#No, or just one that can bake bread would do. She loves bread so, so much, squeak squeak.
31279011.5: She's a little obsessed with bread, squeak...#$b#When we got engaged, my gift to her was a very delicious loaf of bread, squeak.#$b#It was my treasure, made by an excellent human baker, squeak.#$b#We ate it together, each of us starting from one end. We were so happy, squeak squeak.#$b#And now she wants to make bread, cheese bread, and for that she needs an oven, squeak...
31279011.6: You could learn how to build an oven, then build her one out of stone and wood. It's not hard.
31279011.7: You could use human money: save some up and buy one. If you're nervous, I can buy it for you.
31279011.8: Squeak, good idea, squeak...#$b#Let me think it over, squeak. Either way, I want to study this oven, squeak.#$b#It's so amazing. Just open the lid and it bakes whatever's inside, squeak.#$b#Hmm, next time I'll bring Sella to see it too, squeak. She'll be so excited.
31279011.9: Squeak, @?#$b#Is something the matter, squeak?#$b#Looks like you have something to say.
31279011.1_1: Either way, Kerwin, sneaking into someone's home and using their furniture is very rude for a stranger. The same goes for a strange mouse.
31279011.1_2: Oh! Sorry, sorry, squeak.#$b#I'm so very sorry... I didn't know humans don't like this, squeak...#$b#Oh no, actually Sella may have told me, I just didn't really listen, squeak...#$b#Anyway, I'm really sorry, squeak squeak! I won't do it again, squeak.
31279011.2_1: No, I have nothing to say.
31279011.2_2: All right, maybe I guessed wrong. Sorry, squeak.
31279011.10: Who's there?#$b#Maru? Demetrius? Seb? Could one of you check the kitchen?
31279011.11: Oh, it's you, @!#$b#Ever since that Bread Mouse reserve was set up, I keep seeing mice around town. I thought this was another one.#$b#Demetrius has always wanted to see what a talking mouse is like, but those mice keep avoiding him. He's terribly disappointed.#$b#Anyway, I'm a little scared of mice. Glad it's just you.
31279012.2: Is someone, no, some mouse, crying?
31279012.4: What happened? I should follow her.
31279012.5: Oh, hi...#$b#@, I'm sorry, squeak. I lost my composure just now, squeak.#$b#I'm sorry you had to see me like this, squeak.#$b#Sigh, maybe you can guess what's upsetting me, squeak. Yes, it's about my husband.
31279012.6: You know, my husband Felix is an excellent farmer, squeak.#$b#During our wandering days, he always promised me:#$b#Once we settle down, we'll clear a big field, squeak. As long as we work the fields, we'll never go hungry, squeak.#$b#Back then, I truly believed that with fields and food, we would be happy, squeak.#$b#But now that we've really settled down, and that life is within reach, I'm scared, squeak.#$b#Scared of what, squeak? Please don't laugh at me. I'm scared of becoming useless, a burden, squeak.#$b#Even without me, without my foraging experience and skills, there will be plenty of food to eat.#$b#Kerwin can protect everyone, and Sella can cook the food Felix grows into something even tastier, squeak.#$b#And me? I'd be no use at all, squeak.#$b#Please believe me, @. It's not that I don't love my husband, squeak. I love him very much.#$b#But I'm more afraid of becoming useless, of needing him to look after me and provide for me, squeak.#$b#Great Mouse Spirit, squeak! I'd rather go back to our wandering days, when everyone depended on my foraging to fill their bellies!#$b#Oh no, what am I saying? No, it's not like that...
31279012.7: You're wrong, Nina. What do you think I came here to do? I came to forage too. Filling our bellies is only the first step. Believe me, once you have enough to eat, you'll still miss the taste of the wild hills, the taste of nature. Your skills will always be indispensable. You will always be an irreplaceable mouse.
31279012.8: ...Really? Is that so, squeak?#$b#Oh, Great Mouse Spirit bless me, squeak, you're right.#$b#I've been stuck in those wandering days, squeak.#$b#Back then, everyone depended on me. Without me teaching them and leading them to forage for wild fruit and greens, they would have gone hungry, squeak.#$b#I enjoyed that feeling, the feeling that everyone relied on me, that I was indispensable, squeak.#$b#But now that a new life has arrived, I was the first to be afraid, afraid of losing my old place, squeak.#$b#That's not right. It's not right, squeak...#$b#All right, don't worry about me. Thank you, @!#$b#Really, thank you so much. I feel much better, squeak.#$b#But since you put it that way, I'd like to ask you a question too, squeak:#$b#When you go foraging, is it mostly for yourself, or for your sweetheart, squeak?#$b#Who is it that has a whole farm's worth of food and still wants to taste the flavors of nature, squeak?
31279012.1_2: Oh, I know exactly how you feel, squeak!#$b#When food is plentiful, I often just skip the things I don't like, squeak.#$b#I only bring home the things I love to eat, so I'm the only mouse who's never picky, squeak!#$b#Hee hee, too bad that privilege is about to disappear, squeak.
31279012.2_2: I see... Maybe I can learn from you.#$b#Hmm, first I should ask my husband what he likes to eat most, squeak.#$b#Whenever I ask, he always gives vague answers, saying he likes everything, he's not picky, squeak.#$b#Hmph! I clearly saw his face turn green when he ate carrots, squeak squeak!#$b#Now that we have plenty of food, he has no excuse not to tell me, squeak.
31279012.3_1: Sorry, I don't have a partner yet.
31279012.3_2: Ah, you don't have a partner yet, squeak?#$b#Sorry, I'm actually not very familiar with you humans, squeak.#$b#Are you still young? Not ready for romance yet, squeak?#$b#Goodness, @, you have such a big farm. It's time to live with someone you like!#$b#Who do you like in town? Tell me?#$b#Oh no, Great Mouse Spirit, I'm so sorry. We lady mice just love gossip too much...#$b#Never mind, never mind, let's drop it, squeak.
31279012.9: Oh, and @.#$b#Please don't tell my husband about what happened today, squeak.#$b#Thank you so much, thank you so much for your help.#$b#Really, thank you so, so much, squeak.
31279013.1: All right, dinner is ready, squeak!#$b#Everyone, please try my new cooking, squeak!
31279013.3: I've never had food this tasty, squeak!
31279013.4: Your cooking is simply amazing, squeak!
31279013.5: Oh, squeak!#$b#@, what brings you here, squeak?#$b#We're having dinner, squeak, a hearty mouse dinner.
31279013.6: Perfect timing! I just learned a new dish and made plenty tonight. Come try some, squeak!#$b#Come on, come on, I made lots!
31279013.7: I guarantee you've never had better food!
31279013.9: You like it, squeak! Wonderful!#$b#Even @ thinks my cooking is tasty, squeak!#$b#How wonderful, my studying has finally paid off, squeak!#$b#This dish is called Stuffed Bread. You hollow out the bread, fill it with the delicious wild fruit Nina gathered, and roast it on the grill, squeak!#$b#I tried many times, and this time I'm finally happy with it, squeak.#$b#I have you to thank too, @, squeak.#$b#Because you kept my secret, I could keep learning to cook in that human's house, squeak.#$b#I'll keep working hard and try more cooking techniques, squeak!#$b#It's just...
31279013.10: It's just that I'm really running low on bread, squeak.#$b#The recipes I want to learn, Survival Burger and Bruschetta, all need bread, squeak.#$b#Actually, I'd say I love them because of the bread, squeak!#$b#But my bread keeps running out, and I can't make my own, squeak.#$b#That book teaches how to make bread, but every recipe mentions a human oven, squeak.#$b#I don't have an oven, squeak. I've tried many times to use the grill's fire instead.#$b#But it's never as fluffy and fragrant as real bread. I just can't make bread, squeak...#$b#At this rate, once the bread runs out, I won't be able to make anything, squeak...
31279013.11: Don't lose heart, Sella. Getting to taste something this delicious even once already makes us very happy, squeak.#$b#You can focus on other recipes for now, and we'll all think of a solution together, squeak!#$b#Your talent won't be held back by a little loaf of bread, squeak.
31279013.12: That's right, Sella. I promise you, I'll get you an oven, all right, squeak?#$b#A real oven like the humans have, one that bakes bread!#$b#I promise, squeak. I love you, squeak. Don't be sad, squeak.
31279013.13: Thank you all, but the bread is almost gone, squeak...#$b#I really, really want to eat more bread, squeak...
31279013.14: Seeing her like this, you decide to find a way to help her too.
31279014.1: Mouse Valley has been completely transformed: a brand-new mouse house stands to the north, and to the west lie freshly tilled fields and a colorful little stall.
31279014.3: Welcome to the new Mouse Valley, squeak!#$b#Well? Aren't you astonished, squeak?
31279014.4: We didn't let you in during construction because we wanted to surprise you, squeak.
31279014.5: The human workers are amazing. They built such a big house in just a few days, squeak!#$b#There's a cozy living room inside too. The four of us will live there from now on, squeak.
31279014.6: No more squeezing into the iron cabinet to sleep, squeak squeak...
31279014.7: Look over there, squeak. That field and that little stall are both mine!#$b#I'll sell Mouse Vegetable seeds at the stall. Come see me anytime you want to grow some, squeak squeak.
31279014.8: I'll guard the entrance here and keep every monster away from Mouse Valley, squeak.#$b#Once we've settled in, I'll go fight monsters in the mine too, just like I promised, squeak!
31279014.9: I want to learn to make more human food, squeak.#$b#Next time I'll invite you to dinner. I promise it won't be carrots smeared with cheese paste, squeak!
31279014.10: I'll go foraging all over Stardew Valley, squeak. Maybe someday I'll bump into you in the forest, squeak.
31279014.11: We owe all of this to you, @.#$b#From today on, Mouse Valley is one of Stardew Valley's farms, squeak!#$b#You're welcome to visit anytime, squeak squeak!
31279014.13: The mice have begun their farm life in their new home. Come by Mouse Valley often to visit them.
MouseNewYear.name: Mouse New Year
MouseNewYear.Map.1: The mice have put this big abandoned JojaMart crate to good use.
MouseNewYear.Map.2: You spot the Joja logo on these eggplants. It seems the crates weren't the only things picked up from Joja...
MouseNewYear.Map.3: You're sure these vegetables came from your farm. They were sold off, and after a long journey they found their way back to Mouse Valley.
MouseNewYear.Map.4: A whole crate of leeks. You wonder how the mice managed to keep them since spring.
MouseNewYear.Map.5: Once Spirit's Eve is over, the jack-o'-lanterns get thrown away. The mice tossed out the candles and stored the pumpkins.
MouseNewYear.Map.6: The hazelnuts in the crate still carry a strong scent of autumn.
MouseNewYear.Map.7: These blackberries were picked perfectly intact. You can't help thinking of Nina's nimble paws.
MouseNewYear.Map.8: One of the wild plums still has fresh snow on it. Perhaps it's the only wild plum here lucky enough to see snow.
MouseNewYear.Map.9: A pile of books. The one on top is 'The Mouse Hero and the Wicked Great White Cat'.
MouseNewYear.Map.10: This copy of 'The Mouse Cooking Guide' is nearly worn to shreds, but 'A Guide to Breeding Tobacco' looks brand new.
MouseNewYear.Map.11: The ribbon reads: To my beloved wife, Happy New Year!
MouseNewYear.Map.12: The card reads: I kissed this gift somewhere. Guess where! Guess right and you'll get a reward~
MouseNewYear.Map.13: 'The last Fairy Rose of autumn and the first Crocus of winter.'
MouseNewYear.Map.14: These were clearly grown by mice. Tiny paw prints still dot the soil.
MouseNewYear.Map.15: The Mouse Vegetables you know so well, grown by mice themselves.
MouseNewYear.Map.16: The mice's skill at growing human crops is beyond anything you imagined. This basket is full of fruits and vegetables.
MouseNewYear.Map.17: An experimental variety. It's very fragile and must be brought indoors tonight to stay warm.
MouseNewYear.Map.18: Lots of hay. It was spread out to dry in autumn, and when you touch it you can still feel a little warmth.
MouseNewYear.Map.19: You lean in and smell the hay: a natural freshness, the fragrance of soil, and a scent that belongs only to the sun.
MouseNewYear.Map.20: Super super super delicious Stuffed Bread. No need to guess who made it.
MouseNewYear.Map.21: A salad of autumn forage and crops. It smells so fresh.
MouseNewYear.Map.22: The firewood is stacked neatly, quietly waiting to release its heat in winter.
MouseNewYear.Map.23: You can almost picture these logs when they were still standing. They must have come from a tall mahogany tree.
MouseNewYear.Map.24: A woodpecker has already pecked open the wormhole in this log. The worm probably became its lunch.
MouseNewYear.Map.25: An important emergency medicine for snowy days. You wonder how this pet medicine, only sold in Zuzu City, ended up here.
MouseNewYear.Map.26: The barrel holds wine the mice brewed themselves, which they call 'sweet rice wine'. But the wives never let their husbands drink much.
MouseNewYear.Map.27: The mice learned from humans to make some pickles, but only just in case. They don't like food that isn't fresh.
MouseNewYear.Map.28: 'Great Mouse Spirit, thank you for your protection this year. We are doing very well now.' - The Mice
MouseNewYear.Map.29: The warmth of the roaring fire and the aroma of the big grilled salmon... you can't tell which one enchants you more.
MouseNewYear.Map.30: 'Amazing Animals Revealed 4: Are the Island Dragon and the Bread Snake the Same Creature?'
MouseNewYear.MouseFelix: $y 'Do you know where Mouse New Year comes from, squeak?_No_A mouse year begins with winter, so the time when autumn turns to winter is our New Year, squeak.*All the food and firewood at New Year are not just supplies for the winter, squeak squeak. They are also the fruits of a whole year of hard work.*Legend says that long, long ago, squeak, there was a winter so cold and so long that many mice did not survive it.*But thanks to the prayers of a priest, the mice found an abandoned mouse cave full of grain that had been forgotten ten years before, squeak.*The mice believed it was a gift from the Great Mouse Spirit, squeak squeak.*The next winter, to tell the Great Mouse Spirit that the mouse clan had stored enough food, the mice celebrated Mouse New Year for the first time, squeak.*The mice show their stored food to the Great Mouse Spirit, and it gives them confidence for the coming winter, squeak squeak!*Look how much we stored this year. How happy we are, squeak squeak!_Yes_Great, squeak! Then please take a look at the winter supplies we stored this year, squeak squeak!*If you need anything this winter, just let us know, squeak squeak.*Mice and humans should help each other, squeak!'
MouseNewYear.MouseKerwin: Enemies often attack during festivals. I have to protect everyone, so I can't let my guard down now, squeak!
MouseNewYear.MouseNina: Come taste some mouse cooking, squeak squeak! And that's not all: every ingredient came from my husband's and my own hard work, squeak.
MouseNewYear.MouseSella: I wish Kerwin could take a break and really enjoy his favorite Italian bread, squeak... But it's thanks to him that we're safe, squeak.
MouseNewYear.Wizard: The 'Great Mouse Spirit' these mice speak of is not an entirely fictional deity... I may know who they mean.
MouseNewYear.Lewis: Ha! @! You were invited to Mouse New Year too? Look at this mat the mice painted. Simply incredible!
MouseNewYear.Marlon: We'll keep the valley safe, including these lovely mice who are under threat.
MouseFelix.Dialogue.Introduction: Hello, I'm Felix. We've known each other for a while, but let me introduce myself properly: I'm a farmer, just like you.
MouseFelix.Dialogue.Mon2: The crop I hate growing most is garlic. The smell makes a mouse dizzy, squeak.
MouseFelix.Dialogue.Mon4: Blueberries are just too tempting. We always play ball with them for ages before we wash them and eat them, squeak.
MouseFelix.Dialogue.Mon6: Beets look a lot like radishes, but they taste so much better, squeak.
MouseFelix.Dialogue.Mon8: The only crop you can grow in winter is some kind of blue melon, squeak squeak. Honestly, it's bitter.
MouseFelix.Dialogue.Mon10: The sweetest fruit in the world, and the best one for mice, is the Sweet Gem Berry. I ate one once. It was so sweet it nearly knocked me out, squeak squeak.
MouseFelix.Dialogue.Tue2: Green beans are one of my favorite crops, squeak. I love watching them sway in the wind.
MouseFelix.Dialogue.Tue4: I always see you humans picking those green flowers all summer long... What are they for, squeak? What is beer?
MouseFelix.Dialogue.Tue6: Pumpkins are way too big for a mouse, squeak. We could even hollow one out and use it as a little house.
MouseFelix.Dialogue.Tue8: Mice have never understood why humans grow wheat. How are you even supposed to eat the ears, squeak squeak?
MouseFelix.Dialogue.Tue10: Ancient Fruit tastes strange. It isn't sweet at all, and yet I just can't stop eating it, squeak...
MouseFelix.Dialogue.Wed2: Have you ever grown potatoes? Mice like to call them 'dirt dumplings', squeak. Don't you think they're much bigger than beans?
MouseFelix.Dialogue.Wed4: Hmm, last time I tricked Nina into eating a hot pepper, and she didn't talk to me for three days, squeak...
MouseFelix.Dialogue.Wed6: Corn is such a strange-looking plant. The fruit is wrapped up inside the leaves, squeak.
MouseFelix.Dialogue.Wed8: Last time I picked up some seeds you threw away, and they grew into forage, just like the things Nina brings home.
MouseFelix.Dialogue.Wed10: I heard someone brought back a plant called a pineapple from the island across the sea, squeak. I had one bite and my whole mouth went numb.
MouseFelix.Dialogue.Thu2: From what I've seen, you humans always start planting strawberries after the Egg Festival. Is there some deeper meaning to that, squeak?
MouseFelix.Dialogue.Thu4: It's a melon, so how can it be sweeter than candy, squeak... It's a crop made for mice!
MouseFelix.Dialogue.Thu6: Amaranth is so odd. Why would a vegetable be purple, squeak squeak... I don't think I've seen many other purple vegetables.
MouseFelix.Dialogue.Thu8: I never understood why you humans grow tea. So those little green leaves are what you're after, squeak.
MouseFelix.Dialogue.Thu10: Why does that blue melon have a human face? Is there a melon with a mouse face, squeak squeak?
MouseFelix.Dialogue.Fri2: I tried a little rhubarb last time and couldn't eat a thing for the rest of the day, squeak.
MouseFelix.Dialogue.Fri4: From what I've seen, you humans don't really treat radishes as food. That's strange, squeak.
MouseFelix.Dialogue.Fri6: Mice have a love-hate relationship with cranberries. They're so sweet, and yet so sour, squeak squeak.
MouseFelix.Dialogue.Fri8: Carrots taste much better than radishes, squeak. And for some reason, you can find their seeds all over the place in spring.
MouseFelix.Dialogue.Fri10: Those little yellow beans... I ate one last time and couldn't sleep for two days. Maybe mice aren't supposed to eat them, squeak...
MouseFelix.Dialogue.Sat2: Mice can't tell flowers apart, squeak. To me there's no 'Blue Jazz' or 'Tulip', just 'blue flower' and 'red flower', squeak.
MouseFelix.Dialogue.Sat4: The only flower I can recognize is the sunflower, because I love sunflower seeds, squeak squeak. Nobody cracks seeds like a mouse.
MouseFelix.Dialogue.Sat6: What's the actual difference between yams and potatoes, squeak? All I know is that one is planted in spring and the other in fall.
MouseFelix.Dialogue.Sat8: Nina always finds wild grapes in summer, but the grapes I plant don't ripen until fall, squeak squeak. That's so strange.
MouseFelix.Dialogue.Sat10: They say if you plant crops close together, they might grow into a super super giant crop, so tall a mouse can't see the top, squeak squeak.
MouseFelix.Dialogue.Sun2: Why do you humans sell parsnips so cheap, squeak? They're delicious!
MouseFelix.Dialogue.Sun4: What's that pretty fruit shaped like a star called, squeak squeak? Yellow? No, no, I think it was purple...
MouseFelix.Dialogue.Sun6: Broccoli and cauliflower look like the same plant in two colors, but one is planted in fall and the other in spring, squeak.
MouseFelix.Dialogue.Sun8: I never grow artichokes, because I know Sella would turn every one of them into boiled artichoke, squeak...
MouseFelix.Dialogue.Sun10: Mice aren't like humans. We don't like using potions to rush our crops, squeak squeak. You shouldn't force a plant to grow against its nature.
MouseKerwin.Dialogue.Introduction: Hello, my name is Kerwin. I'm a warrior. Protecting my family and friends is my duty.
MouseKerwin.Dialogue.Mon2: There's a gooey kind of monster in the mines. I'm not scared of it, but it's gross, squeak.
MouseKerwin.Dialogue.Mon4: Cold places are a mouse's favorite, squeak. I love the frozen lake on floor 60 of the mines most of all.
MouseKerwin.Dialogue.Mon6: Have you ever seen the shadow people, squeak? They're always fighting the dwarves. I don't think either of them is any good, squeak.
MouseKerwin.Dialogue.Mon8: My master once told me about a flying green serpent. Terrifying for a mouse. Too bad I've never seen one.
MouseKerwin.Dialogue.Mon10: The mines of Stardew Valley are a great place for adventure, squeak, but for me these days they're not much of a challenge anymore.
MouseKerwin.Dialogue.Tue2: Bugs are very easy to kill, but clearing out a few bugs doesn't improve my swordsmanship one bit, squeak squeak.
MouseKerwin.Dialogue.Tue4: Honestly, you should smash more of those wooden crates in the mines. There's lots of good stuff inside, squeak.
MouseKerwin.Dialogue.Tue6: I have to admit, some of the shadow people's magic is amazing. But they say there were once mice who could use magic too, squeak.
MouseKerwin.Dialogue.Tue8: We aren't scared of mummies, just like you humans aren't scared of mouse mummies, squeak.
MouseKerwin.Dialogue.Tue10: Now that I've set foot in the desert cavern, just like my master did, I'm one of the finest mouse warriors there is, squeak.
MouseKerwin.Dialogue.Wed2: Last time, in a sandy patch of the mines, a Duggy suddenly burst out right under my feet. Good thing I spotted it, squeak.
MouseKerwin.Dialogue.Wed4: I think bats are really just bad mice that can fly, squeak.
MouseKerwin.Dialogue.Wed6: Last time Marlon and I ran into a Metal Head. It's such a puzzling monster for a mouse. What is it even for?
MouseKerwin.Dialogue.Wed8: The Pepper Rex seems to be an animal from tens of millions of years ago. I heard that back then, humans and mice were the same animal, squeak.
MouseKerwin.Dialogue.Wed10: There's a tiny stone cave by the market. Invisible things are always whooshing around inside, squeak. It's very scary for a mouse.
MouseKerwin.Dialogue.Thu2: I once saw a swarm of white bugs turn into flying monsters. When will I get to fly, squeak?#$b#Oh, but I don't want to turn into a bug, squeak.
MouseKerwin.Dialogue.Thu4: There are always lots of little black fuzzballs in the mines, squeak. Every time I touch one, my fur turns black.
MouseKerwin.Dialogue.Thu6: Marlon told me that pink fire-breathing monster is called a Squid Kid. Honestly, I can't see what it has to do with squid, squeak.
MouseKerwin.Dialogue.Thu8: Purple monsters all give off a strange feeling that makes a mouse's heart race, squeak. Don't you humans feel it too?
MouseKerwin.Dialogue.Thu10: They say there's a proving ground the dwarves left behind across the sea. Someday I'd like to go see it, squeak...
MouseKerwin.Dialogue.Fri2: You humans are always scared of bugs. That's where we mice are tougher than you, squeak.
MouseKerwin.Dialogue.Fri4: If my fur gets stained black, I usually go wash it off in the frozen lake on floor 60, squeak.
MouseKerwin.Dialogue.Fri6: After floor 81, everything seems to turn red, squeak... I don't really like it.
MouseKerwin.Dialogue.Fri8: I heard there's a bug with a really hard shell? I'd love to find out whether it or my sword is harder, squeak.
MouseKerwin.Dialogue.Fri10: Sometimes I see a blue-skinned human casting spells on the mines, and then spiders show up inside, squeak.
MouseKerwin.Dialogue.Sat2: Flying bugs are so annoying, squeak... I can beat them, but I usually just steer clear of them.
MouseKerwin.Dialogue.Sat4: What's a ghost, squeak? I've never seen one. Maybe ghosts and mice just can't see each other, squeak.
MouseKerwin.Dialogue.Sat6: The red goo monster... Marlon told me it's called a slime. It's hot to the touch, and even hotter when it sticks to your paws, squeak.
MouseKerwin.Dialogue.Sat8: Sometimes stone golems pop out of the rocks, but they're clumsy and can't bend over, so they can never reach us mice, squeak squeak.
MouseKerwin.Dialogue.Sat10: Will that blue-skinned man cast spells on the desert cavern too? I wonder what would show up. A super long flying serpent, squeak?
MouseKerwin.Dialogue.Sun2: Last time I found a crab walking around carrying a rock, squeak. Later Sella made it into crab soup.
MouseKerwin.Dialogue.Sun4: Here's the amazing part: after floor 40, those gooey monsters all turn blue. They're still gross though, squeak.
MouseKerwin.Dialogue.Sun6: The only good thing about the red floors of the mines is the red crabs. They taste even better than crabs from the sea, squeak.
MouseKerwin.Dialogue.Sun8: I always get hit by the bones the skeletons throw, squeak. But I wonder, do they pull those bones off their own bodies?
MouseKerwin.Dialogue.Sun10: Stardew Valley is home to all of us. I'll always fight to protect everyone here, human and mouse alike, squeak squeak.
MouseNina.Dialogue.Introduction: Hi there, my name is Nina. I'm good at foraging for food in the hills and fields. I'm also Felix's wife.
MouseNina.Dialogue.Mon2: Have you ever seen a leek? I really don't like the taste of leeks, squeak squeak.
MouseNina.Dialogue.Mon4: In the forest you humans call Cindersap Forest, there are lots of tasty spring onions, squeak.
MouseNina.Dialogue.Mon6: My husband is allergic to dandelions. I've never met another mouse like that, squeak...
MouseNina.Dialogue.Mon8: Sometimes seaweed washes up on the beach, squeak. It's strangely good in a stew.
MouseNina.Dialogue.Mon10: Felix always says he'll grow enough food that I won't have to work anymore.#$b#Silly him. If I didn't go foraging, what would I even do?
MouseNina.Dialogue.Tue2: My husband loves wild horseradish, squeak squeak. I always pick a little extra.
MouseNina.Dialogue.Tue4: You have to learn to tell red mushrooms from common mushrooms, squeak. I mixed them up by accident last time...
MouseNina.Dialogue.Tue6: A day when I find a Crystal Fruit is surely the luckiest day of the winter, squeak.
MouseNina.Dialogue.Tue8: I always crack open the clams on the beach, squeak. Guessing whether there's anything inside is so much fun.
MouseNina.Dialogue.Tue10: Sella can always turn foods I find hard to swallow into something delicious, squeak.
MouseNina.Dialogue.Wed2: I can always find grapes in summer, squeak squeak, but from what I've seen, you humans only plant grapes in fall. How odd, squeak.
MouseNina.Dialogue.Wed4: In spring you can always find salmonberries in the bushes, squeak squeak, but there's a human in a raincoat who always picks them faster than me, squeak.
MouseNina.Dialogue.Wed6: Wild plums are way too sour, squeak squeak. Last time I got Sella into real trouble. She made a whole pot of sour plum soup and no mouse could drink it.
MouseNina.Dialogue.Wed8: South of your farm there's a mysterious forest, squeak squeak. Before you came, I squeezed past a big log and went there once.
MouseNina.Dialogue.Wed10: I'm always borrowing Kerwin's sword for all sorts of things. Felix once told me Kerwin doesn't actually like that very much, squeak.
MouseNina.Dialogue.Thu2: Fall mushrooms are our favorite food as mice, squeak.
MouseNina.Dialogue.Thu4: Blackberries in fall taste better than salmonberries, squeak.
MouseNina.Dialogue.Thu6: Cave carrots are usually brought back by Kerwin, squeak. He's the only one brave enough to go into those dangerous mines...
MouseNina.Dialogue.Thu8: I once found sea urchins on the beach, squeak. Kerwin split them open with his sword, and they tasted pretty good, squeak squeak.
MouseNina.Dialogue.Thu10: What do you think is across the sea? Are there foods over there we've never seen, squeak squeak?
MouseNina.Dialogue.Fri2: Crocuses don't taste good, squeak... I hardly ever pick them.
MouseNina.Dialogue.Fri4: Hazelnuts taste nice, but they really put our teeth to the test, squeak.
MouseNina.Dialogue.Fri6: Sella loves daffodils, so she can never bring herself to eat them, squeak squeak.
MouseNina.Dialogue.Fri8: If you can gather enough oysters, they make a really tasty stew, squeak.
MouseNina.Dialogue.Fri10: Every part of Stardew Valley has different things to find in different seasons, squeak. I know them all like the back of my paw.
MouseNina.Dialogue.Sat2: Winter root is the only edible thing you can find in winter, so winter is usually my least favorite season, squeak squeak.
MouseNina.Dialogue.Sat4: Morels and mushrooms are two completely different delicacies, squeak squeak.
MouseNina.Dialogue.Sat6: I really wonder what kind of mouse would get so hungry in winter that they'd eat holly, squeak squeak.
MouseNina.Dialogue.Sat8: Apart from that secret forest, I don't think I've ever seen wild fiddlehead ferns, squeak.
MouseNina.Dialogue.Sat10: Kerwin once showed me a coconut shell. He said it was proof that his master had been to the desert, squeak.
MouseNina.Dialogue.Sun2: Spice berries are tasty too, squeak, but they're hard to keep fresh.
MouseNina.Dialogue.Sun4: Next time I'll definitely treat you to chanterelle stew, squeak squeak.
MouseNina.Dialogue.Sun6: Felix always wants to eat sweet peas, but they only grow in summer, squeak squeak.
MouseNina.Dialogue.Sun8: They say there's a delicious food in the desert called a coconut, squeak. I've never been there, but I'd love to see it for myself.
MouseNina.Dialogue.Sun10: The true king of mushrooms is the purple mushroom. Sadly they're so rare that I've only found them twice, squeak.
MouseSella.Dialogue.Introduction: Hello, I'm Sella. I'm a cook, and I know lots of mouse recipes. What? You want me to teach you? *winks*
MouseSella.Dialogue.questComplete_RatSwo: Kerwin brought back the cheese you gave him, squeak! Twenty whole pieces!#$b#Now I can finally try the recipe our family has passed down for generations... Once I get it right, I'll write to you, squeak squeak!
MouseSella.Dialogue.Mon2: I often go to your human saloon to watch that chubby human cook, squeak squeak.
MouseSella.Dialogue.Mon4: Did you know? If we mice eat too much salt, we get an upset stomach, squeak.
MouseSella.Dialogue.Mon6: The first time I tried to make a big hearty meal, I used way too much salt, and our whole family of mice got sick, squeak squeak.
MouseSella.Dialogue.Mon8: Why on earth did you humans invent coffee, squeak? After my first taste I couldn't sleep for a whole day and night.
MouseSella.Dialogue.Mon10: Food safety is the top priority for a mouse chef. I can't let anyone's tummy go wrong.
MouseSella.Dialogue.Tue2: You humans love fried eggs... I feel like you might as well eat them raw, squeak.
MouseSella.Dialogue.Tue4: I tried an omelet for the first time, squeak! I'm never eating raw eggs again, squeak!
MouseSella.Dialogue.Tue6: Last time I saw a human selling a really cold dessert. Aren't you afraid of upsetting your stomach, squeak?
MouseSella.Dialogue.Tue8: I have to say, you humans are masters of dessert. Chocolate cake has completely won me over, squeak.
MouseSella.Dialogue.Tue10: Lots of humans call us bread mice, squeak, but honestly we love cake even more than bread.
MouseSella.Dialogue.Wed2: The human who came up with salad must be a genius, squeak. Now we turn all our vegetables into salad.
MouseSella.Dialogue.Wed4: Turning berries into a tasty sauce makes a salad even better, squeak.
MouseSella.Dialogue.Wed6: I've come up with the most delicious salad ever: radish salad, squeak squeak!
MouseSella.Dialogue.Wed8: Can Red Plate really be called a salad? I don't think so, squeak.
MouseSella.Dialogue.Wed10: Nina only eats salad to lose weight, but she keeps getting low blood sugar. So I made the dressing really sweet... and now Felix keeps getting chubbier, squeak...
MouseSella.Dialogue.Thu2: Baked fish is tasty, but fish are really rare for us, squeak squeak. I like to collect the bones left over when you humans bake fish and make soup with them.
MouseSella.Dialogue.Thu4: After I made fish tacos once, we all kept urging Kerwin to learn how to catch fish, squeak.
MouseSella.Dialogue.Thu6: I used to just throw together any old fish soup, until I saw that human make Fish Stew once, squeak.
MouseSella.Dialogue.Thu8: Spicy Eel scares us, squeak... Oh, it reminds us of snakes.
MouseSella.Dialogue.Thu10: Last time Kerwin brought back a real snake... It was just an ordinary rat snake, but I still didn't have the courage to cook it, squeak.
MouseSella.Dialogue.Fri2: In my opinion, Vegetable Medley is nowhere near as good as salad, squeak.
MouseSella.Dialogue.Fri4: Boiled artichoke always tastes a bit weird, squeak, but it sure is filling.
MouseSella.Dialogue.Fri6: Rhubarb Pie is hard for a mouse to swallow. You humans have such strange taste.
MouseSella.Dialogue.Fri8: Blueberry Tart is the finest delicacy of all, squeak.
MouseSella.Dialogue.Fri10: Dessert is always right! Every mouse should live for the most delicious desserts, squeak squeak!
MouseSella.Dialogue.Sat2: How are cookies even made, squeak? What does that human do in the oven? I can never see clearly, squeak.
MouseSella.Dialogue.Sat4: Guess what I learned? Bread, squeak! Now I want an oven of my own.
MouseSella.Dialogue.Sat6: I burned my very first batch of bread... I'm never making bread again, squeak...
MouseSella.Dialogue.Sat8: I made bruschetta successfully for the first time! A victory for mice!
MouseSella.Dialogue.Sat10: I tried cutting bread into two slices and putting some salad in between. That's my version of a Survival Burger, squeak.
MouseSella.Dialogue.Sun2: Sashimi is great food, squeak. Don't get me wrong, it's because when humans eat it, there are always lots of scraps left over.
MouseSella.Dialogue.Sun4: I really want a pumpkin, squeak squeak. If I had one, should I make pumpkin soup or pumpkin pie...
MouseSella.Dialogue.Sun6: I'd love to get my paws on some pasta sauce, but that human always makes it ahead of time, squeak.
MouseSella.Dialogue.Sun8: Fried calamari is something a mouse can't accept, from the ingredients to the seasoning. You humans like such strong flavors, squeak.
MouseSella.Dialogue.Sun10: Delicious food always lifts your mood. I'm always searching for the foods and recipes mice love most, squeak.
